verdict.rationale: Paddle ships a first-party hosted MCP server, with sandbox and live endpoints, that lets AI agents read data and act in the account. Its docs say that instead of navigating the dashboard or making API calls, you can ask an agent in natural language to handle pricing, refunds, subscription changes, failed-payment investigation and reporting, and a codemode search/execute interface covers the full API. Official plugins bundle this with the docs MCP server and agent skills for Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation, and a native in-product natural-language interface (operation depends on an external agent client; destructive operations are not gated).
